title: Add new release repositories
author: jlblancoc
body:
* Name of the release team: mrpt2

* Release repositories to add:
  * [mrpt_msgs](https://github.com/mrpt-ros-pkg/mrpt_msgs)](https://github.com/mrpt-ros-pkg/mrpt_msgs/tree/ros2)
    * [x] There is an existing release repository which should be imported: https://github.com/mrpt-ros2-pkg-release/mrpt_msgs-release
  * [pose_cov_ops](https://github.com/mrpt-ros-pkg/pose_cov_ops)
    * (There is NOT any existing ros2 release repository for neither this one, nor the rest)
  * [mrpt_slam](https://github.com/mrpt-ros-pkg/mrpt_slam)
  * [mrpt_sensors](https://github.com/mrpt-ros-pkg/mrpt_sensors)
  * [mrpt_navigation](https://github.com/mrpt-ros-pkg/mrpt_navigation)
